name: How long does a typical sliding glass door installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical sliding glass door installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeframe for a sliding glass door can vary based on several factors, including the complexity of the project, whether it's a new opening or a replacement, and any necessary structural modifications. A straightforward replacement might take a single day. However, projects requiring framing adjustments or significant structural work could extend to two or three days. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific needs during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most installations take one to three days, depending on whether it's a replacement or a new opening with structural changes.
